name: kitchen-organization
description:
Designs a zone-based kitchen layout optimized for cooking efficiency. Covers
work triangle design, pantry organization by category, tool hierarchy by
frequency of use, and counter management strategies. Use when the user wants
to organize their kitchen, optimize workflow for cooking, set up a new kitchen,
or reduce time spent looking for tools and ingredients. Do NOT use for general
room organization (use room-organization-system), meal planning (use meal-prep-workflow),
or decluttering an entire home (use decluttering-method).
